notes: Baseline public suite passed58 tests but adversarial review still found defects; new regression scenarios were added.
The local67-pass/1-fail run incorrectly enabled a production-only Turnstile assertion. Local Wrangler has no Turnstile configuration; the failure is recorded, not counted as a production regression.
Local final transfer run uses mocked API and challenge responses, including the two-context crypto round trip.
The earlier22 WebKit checks cover UI/storage source unchanged in the later transfer-only patch. Final public build retest is recorded separately.
